title: fix(plugin-kanban): each column header totals the view's summarizeField (objectui#11629)
body:
Fixes #11629

Clause-②: no

Session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_015W8GBu6sBiqus2L2xjMsAL`. This is the dispatched os-dev run for the `domain:ui` seat 1 claim on this card. The first round resumed from branch head `7c30a25` after a container restart. Patch round 2 adds the producer half under the seat's surface extension, comment `5991348386` on the card.

A kanban view's `summarizeField` now shows as a per-column total on the board. The key is declared in `@objectstack/spec`'s `KanbanConfig` as "Field to sum at top of column". Two halves were missing, and this PR carries both:

- **Producer (app-shell).** On the console object page, `kanbanViewOptions` is the only kanban config `ListView` receives when the stored view row carries no `options.kanban` bag. It relayed `groupByField`, `titleField` and `cardFields`, and dropped `summarizeField`. So on the card's own repro route (`/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task/view/showcase_task.board`) the key never reached `ListView`'s projection or the generated board. It is now relayed when the view declares it.
- **Renderer (plugin-kanban).** The `object-kanban` board never read the key. Each column header now paints the total beside the count.

## What changed

**`packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`, `kanbanViewOptions` only:**

- relays `summarizeField` when the view's `kanban` block declares it;
- leaves the key absent when the view declares none, as with the lane, so no default field is invented.

**`packages/plugin-kanban/src`:**

- **`KanbanColumnSummary.ts`** (new, not re-exported from `index.tsx`):
  - a package-private context holding the field, its label, and `renderTotal`, which writes a total through the field's own cell renderer;
  - `sumLaneField`, the sum of one lane's cards.
- **`ObjectKanban.tsx`**:
  - reads `summarizeField` off the node, typed on `GateBoundKanbanSchema` (the module-local read type that already types the gate-written `sort`);
  - provides the context only once the object definition has settled, the field is declared, and the viewer may read the field.
- **`KanbanImpl.tsx`**:
  - `LaneTotal` paints a `Σ` glyph and the total beside the count, on the flat header and on the swimlane layout's column-title row;
  - the field's label is the total's tooltip and screen-reader name, and the glyph is `aria-hidden`;
  - no translation key is added.

**Docs and changeset:**

- `content/docs/plugins/plugin-kanban.mdx`: one Features line for column totals.
- `.changeset/11629-kanban-column-sum.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` and `@object-ui/app-shell`, both `patch`. The note that the object page did not forward the key is replaced by one sentence for the relay.

Behaviour:

- An absent, `null` or empty value counts as 0, and an empty column totals 0.
- A numeric string counts as the number the card shows for it.
- A column holding any other kind of value shows no total, never `NaN`.
- The total is formatted the way the cards format the field: it goes through the same `getCellRenderer(resolveCellRendererType(def))` call the card fields make. A currency field totals as currency, and a `number` field keeps its declared `scale`.
- A sum over a `number` field with no `scale` is rounded to its widest input, so `0.1 + 0.2` reads `0.3`. This is ruling A′ of objectstack-ai/objectstack#19628, the same reading the grid footer applies.
- A board whose view declares no `summarizeField` renders exactly as before.

## What the total covers

The board has no per-column pager. It makes one query, capped by `$top` (the authored `limit`, else `DEFAULT_KANBAN_FETCH_BATCH_SIZE`), and groups the rows that come back.

- The total covers the cards the board loaded, which is the same set the count counts.
- When that fetch comes back saturated, the total carries the same `+` the count carries (`6+`), so it never reads as the group's full total.
- No aggregate query is added. The board's count does not issue one either.
- On the showcase the fetch is not saturated: 10 task rows against a window of 100, and the data API answers `hasMore: false`. So the totals there are complete.

## Evidence (final head `7e2cb00`)

### Gates

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/`: exit 0, `Test Files 1005 passed | 1 skipped (1006)`, `Tests 9979 passed | 9 skipped (9988)`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-kanban/`: exit 0, `Test Files 66 passed (66)`, `Tests 454 passed (454)`.
- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --concurrency=2`: exit 0, 30/30 tasks (closure via `^build`). The new pin is in the `tsconfig.test.json` program. This and the app-shell lint ran at `91d32af`; the merge that made `7e2cb00` changed no app-shell file.
- `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-kanban...' --concurrency=2` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-kanban type-check`: exit 0 (13/13 tasks), then exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell lint` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-kanban lint`: exit 0 with 0 errors, and no warning on any line this branch adds.
- Each of these exits 0: `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check-changeset-presence` (2 released packages, 1 changeset) and `check-changeset-no-major`.

After the build their own message names (`turbo run build` over `check-doc-snippet-types.mjs --build-filter`, exit 0, 35/35 tasks), `check:doc-snippets` exits 0 (777 of 777 blocks judged, 0 failed) and `check:doc-examples` exits 0 (every covered `@example` compiles or fails as its ledger row declares).

### Pins

- `ObjectView.kanbanSummarizeField-11629.test.ts` (app-shell, new): `kanbanViewOptions` carries `summarizeField` when the view declares it, also on the detector path where the view names no lane. It omits the key when the view's kanban block lacks it, and when the view has no kanban block; the omission arms carry a control that the bag is not empty.
- The other `kanbanViewOptions` readers stay green (6 files, 75 tests together with the new pin): `ObjectView.kanbanLane-8193`, `ObjectView.kanbanGroupByRetired-8213` (its refused-key ratchet is unchanged, because `summarizeField` is a declared spec key), `ObjectView.relayRungCensus-7559`, `ObjectView.storedOptionsBag-10380` and `plugin-list`'s `ListView.strayGroupByRefused-8365`.
- `columnSummarizeField-11629.test.tsx` (plugin-kanban) has 12 rows: mixed values and nulls with an empty column; the label as tooltip and screen-reader name; the NO SUMMARIZE FIELD control; a currency total that reads like the card's cell; `0.1 + 0.2` reads `0.3`; a non-numeric lane; WINDOWED `6+` with an UNSATURATED control; the swimlane title row; DENIED with a READABLE control; an undeclared field.

### Ablations

Each ablation went through `ablation-replace`: the anchor hit once, the blob moved, and the restore was proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The expected direction was written down before each run, and every run went red as expected.

| mutation | pin result |
|---|---|
| relay removed from `kanbanViewOptions` | new pin: 2 failed (the two carry arms), 2 passed |
| relay made unconditional | new pin: 2 failed (the two omission arms), 2 passed |
| flat-header `LaneTotal` render removed | 8 failed, 4 passed (green: the four rows that expect no flat-header total or read the swimlane title row) |
| windowed `+` removed | 1 failed: WINDOWED |
| non-number guard in `sumLaneField` removed | 1 failed: the non-number row |
| FLS gate removed | 1 failed: DENIED |
| undeclared-field gate removed | 1 failed: the undeclared-field row |

The two relay ablations ran in round 2 at `91d32af`. The five plugin-kanban ablations ran in round 1 at `7c30a25`; plugin-kanban has not changed since.

### Live, on the branch head with no mutation

Setup:

- The console ran from this worktree against the objectstack `ba575886` showcase, on a `--fresh` database.
- The task and project view fixtures there are byte-identical to objectstack `main` `27991556`.
- Server truth, summed from `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_task`: backlog 30, todo 36, in_progress 100, in_review 54, done 24. From `showcase_project`: planned 200000, active 750000, on_hold 90000, completed 50000.

| route | headers | board `select` |
|---|---|---|
| `showcase_task.board` (the card's repro) | Σ 30, 36, 100, 54, 24, matching server truth; title `Estimate (h)`; no `NaN` | carries `estimate_hours` |
| `showcase_project.by_status` (currency `budget`) | Σ 200,000.00, 750,000.00, 90,000.00, 50,000.00, and 0.00 for the empty `cancelled` column, matching the cards' `budget` cells | carries `budget` |
| Active Projects page switched to Kanban (its board declares no `summarizeField`) | every header holds only its count badge; 0 totals on the page | carries `budget`, yet no total is drawn |

Round 1 also measured the card's route before the relay: counts only, and no `estimate_hours` in the board's `select`. The showcase "Task Board" interface page resolves the task object's default view, which also declares `summarizeField`, and it shows the same totals. So the interface-page reach is now measured live, not only read from the code.

## Clause-② evidence

Measured on the built `dist/` of plugin-kanban, over the declaration files reachable from the `exports` entry:

- `summarizeField`, `KanbanColumnSummary`, `sumLaneField`, `useKanbanColumnSummary` and `LaneTotal` each occur 0 times. Controls: `ObjectKanbanComponentProps` occurs 6 times and `KanbanRenderer` 11 times.
- `dist/index.js` exports the same ten names, and `index.tsx` is untouched.

In app-shell, the relay adds a key to the object `kanbanViewOptions` returns. It adds no export, no prop, no type member and no i18n key. `kanbanViewOptions` was already exported, for its pin test. Across the PR, the only type-level addition is one optional member on plugin-kanban's non-exported read type `GateBoundKanbanSchema`.

## Acceptance notes

- **`+` on a sum.** It is a lower bound only when the values are non-negative. If a field holds negative values and the window is saturated, `N+` is not a bound; it says only that more rows exist than the window holds. The count uses the same marker, by design.
- **Third copy of the widest-fraction-digits reading.** The grid footer has `widestFractionDigits`, the metric tile has `ownFractionDigits`, and this PR adds `fractionDigitsOf`. Sharing one function needs a new export, which this claim's Clause-② fence rules out. Carrier: none.
- **Package README.** `packages/plugin-kanban/README.md` does not mention `summarizeField`. The surface extension covered one line in the docs page only.
- **`check:unreferenced-sources`** covers only `packages/components`, so it did not judge the new module. The module is imported by `ObjectKanban.tsx` and `KanbanImpl.tsx`, and it is bundled into `dist/index.js`.
- **Serial.** objectui#11643 is in flight on `ObjectView.tsx` in the fallback-tab and `persistViewPatch` region. This PR touches only `kanbanViewOptions` and its doc comment.
- **Not run locally, left to CI:** `check:eager-closure` and `check:sdui-registration-pins` (both need a console build), and the repo-wide `pnpm lint`.
